en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain ibn Mūsā ibn Bābawayh narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali Al-Washā, who said:

I asked Imam Riďā (a.s.) if (the reward for) the Ziyārah of the grave of Abil Ḥasan (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) is the same as the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Imam (a.s.) replied, “Yes.” The above Ḥadīth has also been narrated to me through the following chain: Muḥammad ibn Ya’qūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali Al-Washā, from Imam Riďā (a.s.).
